release.body:
Bind the published Builds 4.43.6 tool, catalog, signed packages, and qualification inventory to Platform source `ed1560a57f4d4cb55b6b03f485cbfa01316837a7`.

Validation: the [exact-source hosted tuple preflight](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Platform/actions/runs/41692654232) passed. The [published SDK catalog builder matrix](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Platform/actions/runs/41692477575) passed all four lanes against this source.

The tuple retains `candidateAcceptance:false`; runtime integration has separate admission requirements. Platform publishes no NuGet package in this release.
